scientific_scope_status: The source targets chi(G)<=2h(G) for every finite simple graph, where h is complete-minor order. This universal target remains UNRESOLVED. For H on even N>=4 vertices and G=complement H, D=Delta(H), C=max_v induced-four-cycle incidence (each cycle once), set L=(1-x)^D(1-y)^C for x,y in(0,1). Conditions 1/(N-1)<=xL^2 and 1/[(N-1)(N-3)]<=yL^4 certify a pairwise-touching perfect matching of G and hence h(G)>=N/2. Uniform complete-graph matching bad events are forbidden H edges and the two diagonals of induced H four-cycles. Established canonical-event negative dependency and the lopsided local lemma are substantive imports, not a newly invented local lemma.
